title: Red Fox (Yellowstone Sound Library)
author: NPS / Shan Burson
changes: Recording of a red fox (Vulpes vulpes) barking, a close cousin of the fennec fox. Trimmed to 0.55–2.85 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
